scripts.build:electron: tsc electron/main.ts --outDir dist-electron --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('electron/preload.cjs','dist-electron/preload.cjs'); if(fs.existsSync('electron/icon.png')) fs.copyFileSync('electron/icon.png','dist-electron/icon.png');"
scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run build:electron
